scenario.name: sampling-rate-limit
scenario.description: Rate-limit drop rules counting records and bytes, across batches.

schema.name: LogRecord

fields.name: uuid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the log record.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the trace this log is a part of.

fields.name: span_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the span within the trace.

fields.name: trace_flags
fields.doc: Flags associated with the trace.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: The primary timestamp of the event, in microseconds since epoch.

fields.name: observed_timestamp
fields.doc: The timestamp when the event was observed or ingested, in microseconds since epoch.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The main content or message of the log.

fields.name: severity_text
fields.doc: Human-readable severity level (e.g., 'INFO', 'ERROR').

fields.name: severity_number
fields.doc: Numeric representation of the severity level.

fields.name: service_name
fields.doc: The name of the service that generated the event.

fields.name: resource_attributes
fields.doc: Attributes describing the resource that produced the log (e.g., host, region).

fields.name: instrumentation_scope
fields.doc: The name of the library or framework that captured the log.

fields.name: event_name
fields.doc: The name of a specific event that occurred.

fields.name: attributes
fields.doc: A map of custom string-valued attributes associated with the log.

fields.name: bytes_uncompressed
fields.doc: Logical content size of the row (sum of byte lengths of string/map fields). Used by drop-rule accounting; does not include fixed-width numeric or timestamp fields.

fields.name: retention_days
fields.doc: Per-row retention in days, stamped by the Node consumer from team retention rules. Null when unset — ClickHouse then falls back to the batch `retention-days` header. capture-logs always writes null; it does not evaluate team rules.

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: Masked log body, stamped by the Node consumer. Identifiers are replaced with placeholders, so two lines differing only by a request id share one pattern. capture-logs always writes null; it does not mask.

fields.name: pattern_version
fields.doc: Masking rule set that produced `pattern`. A rule change re-masks every line, so the detector compares within a version and treats a change as a cold start. Null reads as version 0 in ClickHouse, marking a row written before masking. capture-logs always writes null.
